BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to hunters under the age of fourteen; and amendingRCW 77.32.010 and 77.15.160.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.32.010 and 2008 c 329 s 923 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as otherwise provided in this chapter, a recreationallicense issued by the director is required to hunt for or take wildanimals or wild birds, fish for, take, or harvest fish, shellfish, andseaweed. A recreational fishing or shellfish license is not requiredfor carp, smelt, and crawfish, and a hunting license is not requiredfor bullfrogs. (2) A permit issued by the department is required to park a motorvehicle upon improved department access facilities. (3) All hunters under the age of fourteen are required to beaccompanied by a Washingtonlicensed hunter age eighteen or older whenhunting for wild animals or wild birds. The accompanying adult huntermust stay within a physical range that permits continual unaided visualand auditory communication with the accompanied hunter. p. 1 SHB 1114 (4) During the 200709 fiscal biennium to enable the implementationof the pilot project established in section 307, chapter 329, Laws of2008, a fishing permit issued to a nontribal member by the ColvilleTribes shall satisfy the license requirements in subsection (1) of thissection on the waters of Lake Rufus Woods and on the north shore ofLake Rufus Woods, and a Colville Tribes tribal member identificationcard shall satisfy the license requirements in subsection (1) of thissection on all waters of Lake Rufus Woods.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.15.160 and 2000 c 107 s 237 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A person is guilty of ((an)) a natural resources infraction, whichshall be cited and punished as provided under chapter 7.84 RCW, if theperson: (1) Fails to immediately record a catch of fish or shellfish on acatch record card required by RCW 77.32.430, or required by rule of thecommission under this title; ((or)) (2) Fishes for personal use using barbed hooks in violation of anyrule; ((or)) (3) Engages in unaccompanied hunting in violation of the minimumage requirements established in RCW 77.32.010; or (4) Violates any other rule of the commission or director that isdesignated by rule as an infraction.
